Name: Junimos Max
Author: TENKAITENSHI
Description:
[heading][b]1. 📈 Progressive Hut Leveling System (Levels 1 to 5)[/b][/heading]
Each outdoor Junimo Hut features its own independent progression level. Huts can be upgraded in-game by visiting the [b]Wizard's Tower[/b] (using his magical construction book) or adjusted freely using [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b].
[table][tr][th]Level[/th]
[th]Harvest Radius[/th]
[th]Upgrade Cost[/th]
[th]Unlocked Abilities[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Level 1[/b][/td]
[td][b]18 x 18[/b] [i](radius 8)[/i][/td]
[td]Base level[/td]
[td]Extended symmetrical square harvest area.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Level 2[/b][/td]
[td][b]30 x 30[/b] [i](radius 14)[/i][/td]
[td]5,000g[/td]
[td][b]Work in the Rain:[/b] Junimos ignore bad weather and harvest continuously during rainy days and storms.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Level 3[/b][/td]
[td][b]42 x 42[/b] [i](radius 20)[/i][/td]
[td]10,000g[/td]
[td][b]Winter Operations:[/b] Junimos stay active throughout winter.
[b]Automatic Daily Watering:[/b] Waters all tilled crop tiles within the harvest radius every morning.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Level 4[/b][/td]
[td][b]54 x 54[/b] [i](radius 26)[/i][/td]
[td]15,000g[/td]
[td][b]Auto-Replanting:[/b] Junimos automatically plant matching seeds into empty tilled soil by drawing from your linked Seed Chests.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Level 5[/b][/td]
[td][b]70 x 70[/b] [i](radius 34)[/i][/td]
[td]20,000g[/td]
[td][b]Massive Coverage:[/b] Expands coverage to 70x70 tiles, allowing one hut to handle an entire mega-farm.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][line]
[heading][b]2. 🏡 Indoor Mini-Huts for Greenhouses & Sheds[/b][/heading]
Vanilla Stardew Valley restricts Junimos strictly to exterior farm maps. [b]Junimos Máximos[/b] overcomes this by introducing [b]1x1 Indoor Mini-Huts[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]How to Obtain:[/b] Purchase a Mini-Hut through the magical book at the Wizard's Tower for [b]5,000g[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Where to Place:[/b] Mini-huts are compact craftable structures designed exclusively for indoor locations: [b]The Greenhouse[/b] or [b]Sheds[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Smart Linking:[/b] When purchasing, select which outdoor parent hut it connects to. The Mini-Hut [b]inherits the level, upgrades, and abilities[/b] of its linked parent hut.[/*]
[*][b]Unified Logistics:[/b] Harvests gathered indoors flow directly into the same smart sorting network.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][b]3. 📦 Smart Chest Sorting Network[/b][/heading]
Never spend time manually sorting mixed crops again. The mod features an automated routing network across [b]5 specialized chest categories[/b]:
[list=1]
[*]🍓 [b]Fruit Chest (Ruby Red):[/b] Gathers all harvested crops classified as fruits, plus orchard tree fruits.[/*]
[*]🥦 [b]Vegetable Chest (Emerald Green):[/b] Collects all harvested vegetables.[/*]
[*]🌸 [b]Flower & Forage Chest (Orchid Pink):[/b] Stores flowers and seasonal foraged items.[/*]
[*]🌱 [b]Seeds & Inputs Chest (Amber / Orange):[/b] Stores seeds and fertilizers. Junimos retrieve seeds from this chest for [b]Level 4 auto-replanting[/b].[/*]
[*]💎 [b]Minerals & Treasures Chest (Sapphire Blue):[/b] Gathers ores, geodes, gems, and mined resources.[/*]
[/list][b]How to Assign a Smart Chest:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Place a regular chest anywhere near your hut or farm layout.[/*]
[*]Right-click your Junimo Hut to open the [b]Custom Hut Menu[/b].[/*]
[*]Click the category you wish to set up (e.g., [i]"Fruit Chest"[/i]).[/*]
[*]The game will prompt you to click the target chest in the world. Once clicked, it will automatically adopt the theme color and badge.[/*]
[*]Click [b]"Transfer Products to Special Chests"[/b] in the hut menu anytime to instantly route all stored inventory items to their designated containers.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][b]4. 🌾 Comprehensive Farm Automation[/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Giant Crop Harvesting:[/b] Junimos automatically harvest giant cauliflowers, melons, and pumpkins.[/*]
[*][b]Fruit Tree Harvesting:[/b] Ripe fruit hanging from nearby trees is gathered daily.[/*]
[*][b]Debris & Dead Crop Clearing:[/b] Junimos clear wilted seasonal crops and spreading weeds, keeping the soil ready for replanting.[/*]
[*][b]All-Weather Reliability:[/b] Levels 2 and 3 ensure zero downtime regardless of heavy rain, lightning, or winter freezes.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][b]5. 🎮 Controls, Keybindings & Console Commands[/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][b][K] Key (Configurable):[/b] Toggles the [b]Harvest Radius Overlay[/b] on/off, visually highlighting the active square boundary on your ground tiles.[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI Console Commands:[/b]
[list]
[*][code]junimo_scan[/code]: Scans the surrounding area and displays all nearby Junimo Huts, mini-huts, crops, and chests in the console.[/*]
[*][code]junimo_clean[/code]: Instantly triggers a radius cleanup of weeds and dead crops around the player.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][b]6. ⚙️ Configuration & GMCM Integration[/b][/heading]
If you have [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] installed, you can press the gear icon on the title screen or open the in-game options menu to customize:
[list]
[*]Toggle auto-watering, replanting, rain work, or winter work individually.[/*]
[*]Custom radius settings for each level tier (from 18x18 up to 70x70 or your own custom values).[/*]
[*]Change the overlay hotkey (default is [b]K[/b]).[/*]
[*]Enable/disable smart chest routing and auto-transfer behaviors.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Junimos Maximos
Manifest.Description: Junimo work, levels, stable population, smart chests and linked indoor huts. Keeps the native exterior hut unless an optional layout mod is installed.
Manifest.Author: Tenkai Tenshi
